text:
hana: FYI someone spotted an email leak in ephemeral captures from the debug-canary. small sample but still 🤦
kevin: where was this captured? route? cohort?
hana: route=payment-inspect, cohort=canary-2, sample contains a customer email in the resp body. i put the raw snippet into secure slack #priv-audit.
priya: is this from the new 'unmask-temp' feature we enabled last week for traceability?
hana: yes, that toggle was on for 5% tenants.
mira: priority: flip the toggle for that cohort + pause sampling for that route. we can't leave raw PII flowing.
kevin: agreed. ops-bot can you run the feature rollback and lower sampler?
ops-bot: command received. executing: `redctl feature set unmask-temp --env=prod --cohort=canary-2 --state=off`
deploy-bot: feature set applied. audit_id=af12c4
ops-bot: pausing sampler: `POST /internal/sampler` body `{route: "payment-inspect", rate: 0}`
priya: let's not completely kill all visibility. can we enable hashed-only sampling (sha256) for PII fields so SRE can still debug?
kevin: good call. hashed-sample reduces risk. we should also add a policy: any route with route.meta.pii=true must override unmask toggles and force-scrub.
hana: who owns the enforcement? eng-runtime should enforce at the process boundary. eng-platform should provide metadata and console indicators.
mira: i'll make a quick ticket. also need a console change: when enabling unmask, show an explicit modal that lists the routing rules that will bypass scrubbing and require an approval checkbox.
priya: add telemetry events: `audit.sampler.pause` and `security.unmask.rollback` with actor and reason. ops-bot can emit these.
ops-bot: Emitted event `audit.sampler.pause` { actor: "kevin", route: "payment-inspect", old_rate: "0.1", new_rate: "0" }
kevin: do we have a fast path to revoke already-stored ephemeral captures?
hana: we have them in `s3://redwood-ephemeral/payment-canary-1779990001/`. i'm running lifecycle policy to quarantine and then legal can review.
mira: note: we should add a circuit-breaker rule in the sampler config: any route flagged with sensitivity=HIGH cannot be unmasked without a signed approval token.
priya: implementation plan: eng-platform adds route metadata + admin approval token flow; eng-runtime checks token at request-time before applying unmask. roll out as feature-flagged change.
kevin: timeline? this is medium priority. i can allocate a small team tomorrow for a 1-week sprint to get a MVP (admin token check + console warning).
hana: in the interim, let's ship hashed-only sampling default for all canaries. low lift: sampler already supports transforms. set transform=sha256(prefix) for fields matching email/phone.
ops-bot: Sampler config update applied for canary-2: transform=sha256(prefix) for fields matching /email|phone/i
priya: add a short runbook entry for oncall: steps to flip unmask, pause sampler, snapshot captures, and contact legal/sec. put in /runbooks/ephemeral-unmask.md
kevin: also need a nightly job to scan recent captures for raw PII leakage alerts and raise a PagerDuty if found.
mira: ok adding an issue: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/8012 (canary-unmask-circuit-breaker) and https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/8013 (console-unmask-warning).
hana: action items: hana -> snapshot & quarantine; priya -> hashed-sampling config; kevin -> PD scan; mira -> tickets + RFC; eng-runtime -> token enforcement prototype.
kevin: thanks team. we'll reconvene after the snapshot is handed to legal. please keep messages short in the audit thread so we can paste into the incident note. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Recorded incident mitigation actions.
deploy-bot: Post-deploy checks: no further unmasked samples detected in canary after config change.
